baseline.head: 875d849e0079452557374690b14e42c546ba2c06
baseline.scope: Exact file hashes below, not a clean-tree claim; audit campaign is excluded evidence.

conclusion: APPROVED FOR ROOT-OWNED BOUNDED CHILD PROBE ONLY; broader emulator execution is blocked on the separately recorded list-error edge until repaired/reviewed.
proof: Backend/ABI/self-task token capability initialized before any fixture spawn. Three static fixtures spawn no build/server/emulator and naturally exit after approximately 12/12.2 seconds (parent of detached child sleeps 2 seconds); scheduling delays are not a hard real-time guarantee.

Only task-created waitable direct children grant group enumeration: waitid(P_PID,WNOHANG|WEXITED|WNOWAIT) before each scan; reaping/revocation ends the grant. Known descendants use stable PID/UID/start tuples and refreshed kernel audit tokens. No numeric signal or killpg fallback exists.

Actual xnu-12377.61.12 source establishes task_name_for_pid same-user eligibility (subject to MAC policy), TASK_AUDIT_TOKEN on a name port, signal API errno return and kernel PID-generation/reference binding. Read failures fail instead of authorizing numeric fallback.

Probe requires ordinary owner observation, post-exec /bin/sleep observation, and a detached nonowner-PGID child observation before stopping. Each scenario requires retired/reaped owner and no observed surviving owned workers.

Updated SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers only set cancellation flags, installed before spawn. Cancellation cannot split Popen/registration or interrupt finalization; next controlled check fails, final receipt cannot be PASS after observed cancellation.

Any failure preserves FAIL. Finally performs shutdown and receipts; failed probe waits until last-spawn+16 seconds, retries cleanup without changing failure into pass. No unrelated workers/files are targeted.
counter_evidence_and_limits: 37 synthetic tests are not actual Darwin execution. I read all 16 native-control tests and root actual37-test log/receipt; sibling21-test implementation was reviewed by root, not claimed as my source coverage.
The new real probe cannot prove all detached descendants in arbitrary third-party process trees were observed, nor any app/network behavior.

DarwinBackend._list currently treats native wrapper zero+errno as empty: exact libproc.c45-58 returns0 for syscall failure and wrapper76-96 preserves0; broader worker enumeration must reject this. Probe expected-observation assertions and short fixture self-exit fail safely, but this is not broad-runner approval.

Uncatchable SIGKILL, interpreter/native crashes, or severe scheduling suspension cannot be made reliable by Python finally; bounded fixture code reduces retained-worker risk but no such interruption was executed here.
Execution must use /usr/bin/python3 -B without optimization (-O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE), since probe uses Python assertions.

requested_probe_correction.original: No SIGTERM handler, so cancellation could bypass evidence/finalization.
requested_probe_correction.current: Source corrected111-line probe reread in full; no-raise flags and final failure check address it.

separate_candidate.status: SOURCE-PROVEN CANDIDATE REPORTED TO ROOT; FIX/INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION PENDING
separate_candidate.recommendation: After resetting errno and calling wrapper, reject count==0 with nonzero errno in addition to negative count. Cover error0+EPERM, empty0+errno0, ordinary counts, ceiling; re-freeze and rerun root synthetic suite.

cleanup: Reviewer executed only finite source/header reads and authoritative source retrieval. No build/native/app/test/server workers or generated build outputs started by reviewer; Python -B used. Required compact research/review retained.
